svg.title: One Model, Automated Membership, Checked Outputs
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-crm-attribution-architecture; chapter number: 11; chart type: org_architecture; title: One Model, Automated Membership, Checked Outputs; subtitle: CRM attribution and AI-assisted sales stack; caption: Pick a model, stay consistent, and stop hiding inside blended CAC; campaign membership is marketing's job and should be automated.; assumptions note: Practitioners did not report team sizes; the hub is a function, not a headcount. KPIs are each operator's own thresholds.; note: Sources - SalesLabX (JkmlKUCHcmA), Value-First (NZUqq5BtQuU), AI Automation Official (bQPaiBg-cWs), Ambilio (oWWC4Sj-SjA).; center: role: Marketing Operations Owner; headcount: Not reported by practitioners; focus: One consistent attribution model and automated campaign membership, so no rep ever touches it (SalesLabX).; spokes: role: Salesforce Campaign Automation; type: Hidden UTM campaign-ID field plus Flow; kpi: Zero manual campaign adds; 180-day influence window matched to the real cycle (SalesLabX).; role: Pipeline Hygiene; type: Monday exception report by rep; kpi: Closed-won near 30% of pipeline; no $60k-$100k deal on a single contact (SalesLabX).; role: HubSpot Multi-Touch Model; type: 7 workflows and 80-some fields in HubSpot Pro; kpi: 12 baseline channels rolling up to 100% for the board (Value-First).; role: AI Outreach and Proposal Agent; type: n8n agent with source-line fact checks; kpi: 4-7 sentence emails, tested on 5-10 leads first; no discounts or dates promised (AI Automation Official, Ambilio).
